args.lesson: Bounded STOP. What worked: Shopify Community is Discourse, and its public JSON endpoints (search.json?q=...order:latest, /t/<id>.json) returned HTTP 200 with created dates, post counts and accepted-answer flags. That is cheap, structured, search-engine-free discovery for request screening. What failed: the only recent (<=90 days) relevant topic, 683136, was a tool builder's market survey ($19 one-time diff tool idea), not a merchant request. Its job (diffing a supplier file against a prepared Shopify CSV) is not what our transformer does. Observed market facts (untrusted): free Shopify CSV checkers are already being promoted, and a vendor advertises fixed USD 25 CSV repair. So the space is crowded with a low price anchor. Next time: before preparing answers, filter the JSON by created_at, has_accepted_answer and posts_count=1-3 in one EXEC. Do not reopen Shopify CSV tooling; posting would need a Community account we do not hold.
